pharmacology.text: Medetomidine is a racemic mixture of two optical or stereoisomers, levomedetomidine and dexmedetomidine. The latter causes the alpha 2- adrenergic agonist effects. Medetomidine is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist that binds at a ratio of 1620:1 with imidazoline receptor activity.

uses.text: Medetomidine is a veterinary anesthetic medication with potent sedative effects. As of December 2025, it is an emerging illicit drug adulterant. It was developed by Orion Pharma.

sideEffects.text: Following administration, marked peripheral vasoconstriction and bradycardia are noted. Medetomidine administration in sheep activates pulmonary macrophages that damage the capillary endothelium and alveolar type I cells. This in turns causes alveolar haemorrhage and oedema causing hypoxaemia.

fact.en: Medetomidine was developed by the Finnish company Orion Pharma. One of its two mirror-image forms, dexmedetomidine, became a sedative for people in intensive care, while the mixture is used to sedate animals.
